name: GPT-6 Astra Pro
description: GPT-6 Astra Pro is the same underlying GPT-6 Astra model served with reasoning.mode set to pro for higher-quality responses on complex tasks.

links.title: GPT-6 Astra: A new generation of intelligence

details.name: reasoning_mode
details.value: Uses reasoning.mode=pro by default; standard mode remains available on the base GPT-6 Astra model slug.

details.name: availability
details.value: Available through Phaseo for OpenAI API accounts with GPT-6 Astra access.

details.name: reasoning_effort
details.value: Supports low, medium, high, xhigh, and max.

details.name: prompt_caching
details.value: Cached input is $1 per million tokens and cache writes are $12.50 per million tokens at Standard rates.

details.name: long_context_pricing
details.value: Requests above 272K input tokens use 2x input and cache rates and 1.5x output rates for the full request.

details.name: service_tiers
details.value: Batch and Flex cost 50% of Standard rates; Fast mode costs 2x the applicable rates.

details.name: zero_data_retention
details.value: Supported for eligible OpenAI API customers.

page_notice.markdown: GPT-6 Astra Pro is a Phaseo model variant that requests OpenAI's documented gpt-6-astra API model with reasoning.mode set to pro. Availability depends on the connected OpenAI account having access.
